one_line: Open on one big offer word over a real reading moment, then end on the dedication page.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static high-angle shot: a mother, a father and a baby read an open book on a couch before mermaid balloons. Glowing pink text with sparkles at the top: "הגרלה"; from 0:01 "אחת מכן! הולכת לזכות". No speech.
q1_hook.why: "הגרלה" is a concrete reason to stay in the first word (H1, T3), over a real family moment with the book already open (S1, K8). It is text only, with no voice (H4, H6), and the glow and sparkles are loud for a native look (H8).

beats.what: Parents and a baby read an open book before mermaid balloons; glowing "הגרלה", "אחת מכן! הולכת לזכות"
beats.why: A free prize and a real moment together

beats.what: Still of a girl in pink with a flame character, title cropped; "בספר האישי הכי מרגש"
beats.why: Shows what the prize looks like

beats.what: A turtle in a gift box, then the girl with coloured creatures; "עם השם שלו הדמות שלו"
beats.why: The claim, over stills with no person

beats.what: Handheld close-ups of printed pages: a characters page, then the dedication page; "ספר אחד לבחירה במתנה לאחת מכן"
beats.why: A real printed object at last

beats.what: The dedication page with an illustrated family, held steady; "כל הפרטים בתיאור 👇"
beats.why: A pointer to the entry rules

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: In the video, only "כל הפרטים בתיאור 👇". Caption: follow two accounts, like, comment and tag someone you would surprise with such a book; a story share is optional.
q2_flow.why: A new picture or text card every 1 to 3 s keeps it moving (R3), and 18 s is short for one idea (R2, R1). The middle 9 s are stills under glowing text, with no person or live footage (F8). The printed book appears only at 0:13 (S1).

q3_cta.what: On screen at 0:13 "ספר אחד לבחירה במתנה לאחת מכן" and at 0:16 "כל הפרטים בתיאור 👇"; not spoken. Caption: follow the creator and @funsomeil, like, comment and tag, an optional story share; draw on 10.08.26.
q3_cta.why: The video points once to the caption, after the prize is shown (C6), but the pointer sits at the edge of the bottom 35%. The caption stacks four actions (C1). Like, follow and tag are asked for the count (C2), though the tag names a person and a reason (C4).

q4_shown.what: A mother, a father and a baby reading the book before balloons, 0:00-0:04; full-page illustrations of a girl in pink, a party scene, coloured creatures, 0:04-0:13; printed pages, a characters page and a dedication page, 0:13-0:18. No price, no real photo beside a page.
q4_shown.why: The book is open and in use from 0:00 (S1), and the printed dedication page, held about 3 s, shows a real object with a name (S2). The 9 s of stills show no hands or paper. No customer voice vouches for it (S6). The baby's face with a name goes against S5.

q5_edit.what: 4 shots detected in 18.2 s (cuts at 4.3, 7.0 and 13.0 s), but a text card changes every 1 to 3 s. Slow push-ins on the illustration stills. Hard cuts. No speech. Ends on the dedication page with the pointer.
q5_edit.why: A text change in the first second and a cut at 4.3 s keep it moving (E1, E2). Nine seconds of slow stills are a slideshow, not live video (F8). With no voice, the message rides on text alone (E4, H6). No dead tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A giveaway of one personalised book, shown through a family reading and the book's pages. It serves viewers who want a free book or a gift to give.
q6_topic.why: The free prize is the draw, and no listed principle covers giveaways. The family reading gives a warm human moment (K8, K1), and "to surprise someone with such a book" is a gift idea worth sending on (R5).

q7_filmed.what: A static high-angle medium shot of two parents and a baby on a couch before mermaid balloons, in window light; illustration stills with the title cropped; handheld close-ups of printed pages on a cloth.
q7_filmed.why: A real home and a family moment look native (H8, K8). The stills are not filmed for this Reel and their titles are cut (F3). The page close-ups are sharp and the dedication text fills the frame (F4, F1).

q8_text.on_screen: Large white text with a black outline and glow, 1 to 3 lines, mostly 16 to 40% down, a new card every 1 to 3 s, with sparkles and emoji: "הגרלה" in glowing pink (0:00), "אחת מכן! הולכת לזכות" (0:01), "הילד שלכם הופך לכוכב של הסיפור" (0:06), "סיפור אישי עם מסר חינוכי" (0:11), "ספר אחד לבחירה במתנה לאחת מכן" (0:13), "כל הפרטים בתיאור 👇" (0:16, about 65% down).
q8_text.caption: Opens with "🎁הגרלה🎁". About 110 words in short blocks: why she runs it, four entry steps with emoji bullets, the draw date, the winner announcement, a rules pointer, a platform disclaimer. No hashtags; the brand tag sits in the first paragraph.
q8_text.why: A one-word headline from 0:00 in big outlined type works muted (T3, T1, T5), but glow cards in the centre cover the illustrations (T2). The caption's first line is the hook (T7). The brand's part is stated in the first paragraph, after "more", with no disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: Four entry asks for the count, including a like and a tag; 9 s of stills under glowing text; no voice; the pointer only at the end; loud glow effects; the brand relationship below the fold.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a page flip and a dedication-page close-up with one offer word over it, no child; keep the entry to one step.
not_verified: Whether the family clip repeats the earlier Reel's scene (it looks like the same family and balloons); whether the stills come from the printed book (the turtle image is not on a page I saw); music, as the transcript is only "תודה רבה"; the prize terms in the brand's bio link. Correction to coded file: 0:04-0:13 is stills with a slow push-in, and no phone interface shows, so it is not a screen recording. The cover title and dedication carry the child's name, not quoted.
